title: Live check after restart: a "never" Codex root can use TermAl's mailbox and read-only MCP tools without approval, and spawn stays refused
outcome: This item confirms in the running product what w-af604716cb6b establishes from the generated session configuration: a Codex root session with approvalPolicy "never" can call TermAl's mailbox and read-only coordination MCP tools without an approval prompt, and TermAl's steering tools stay refused under "never". It is a follow-up to w-af604716cb6b, created so that the source-level item can land under the standing rule while the live observation is tracked on its own. If the live check fails, that failure is a new bug in its own right.
acceptance: After a build containing the w-af604716cb6b change is installed and Greg has restarted the host, one local Codex root session created with approvalPolicy "never" calls termal_send_to_session and termal_read_mailbox successfully without any approval prompt, and its termal_spawn_session call is refused. The session, build hash, times and exact tool results are recorded.

The record states the remaining limit honestly. A root that starts on "never" does not exercise the policy-crossing detach/resume path. If that path is observed live, it is recorded too, but it is not required. Any failure is filed as its own bug with the observed error.
